resource_measurement.generator_cpu_and_peak_rss: os.wait4() rusage of the generator process (ru_utime, ru_stime, ru_maxrss); covers the whole process lifetime
resource_measurement.generator_and_target_samples: /proc/<pid>/stat utime+stime and /proc/<pid>/status VmRSS sampled every 0.25 s (clock tick resolution 10 ms)
resource_measurement.target_cpu: difference of /proc/<pid>/stat utime/stime of the target process between immediately before the measured generator starts and immediately after it exits
resource_measurement.target_peak_rss: VmHWM of the target process after resetting it via /proc/<pid>/clear_refs (5) after warm-up, so it covers only the measured run
resource_measurement.cpu_utilisation_normalisation: *_pct_1cpu = cpu_seconds / wall_seconds * 100 (100 = one logical CPU busy); *_pct_alloc = *_pct_1cpu / 4 (share of the 4 CPUs the process was pinned to)
resource_measurement.tcp_counters: /proc/net/snmp Tcp ActiveOpens/AttemptFails deltas (system-wide) and TIME_WAIT sockets from /proc/net/tcp{,6}
resource_measurement.unavailable: pidstat, perf, /usr/bin/time not used (perf and GNU time not installed); cgroup memory.peak of the container not readable without root

target.contents: FROM scratch with the statically built bench/server binary, USER 1000:1000
target.endpoints: /fast writes 'ok' (2 bytes) immediately; /slow sleeps 10 ms then writes 'ok'
target.listen: 127.0.0.1:8099 (host network namespace, loopback; no Docker NAT/proxy)
target.http: Go net/http server defaults, HTTP/1.1, keep-alive enabled

arrangement.description: Client and server share one laptop. Generators pinned to CPUs 4-7 (4 E-cores) with taskset; target pinned to CPUs 8-11 (4 E-cores) with --cpuset-cpus; harness, OS and background processes run unpinned and mostly on the P-cores 0-3. Traffic uses the loopback interface.

protocol.order: per experiment group, all configuration x repetition items shuffled with random.Random(f'{seed}-{group}'); groups run sequentially A, B, C, D, E, F
protocol.cooldown: min 3 s; extended (max 30 s) while whole-system CPU busy > baseline + 10 points, TIME_WAIT is not drained: each warm-up recreates the pool before its measured run; time_wait_before_measured records it
protocol.http_version: HTTP/1.1 (plaintext), keep-alive enabled by every tool
protocol.scope_reduction: httpload-only rerun of groups A, C, D, E with the same plan, seed and protocol as 20261101T155011Z (3 reps, 3 s warm-up, 10 s measured; D: c=1000, 2 reps). Groups B (k6/wrk/hey), F (monitor), microbenchmarks and latency accuracy were not rerun: external tools are unchanged, and the monitor/fake-sender measurements do not exercise the changed connection pool.
